title: Runs under concatenated choice words
statement: Let $M$ be a nondeterministic multi-tape Turing machine, let $w,w'$ be finite Boolean words, and let $c$ be a configuration of $M$ on a fixed input. Running $M$ from $c$ under the concatenation $ww'$ gives the same configuration as first running it under $w$ and then running it under $w'$ from the resulting configuration.
hypotheses_covered: A configuration $c$ on a fixed input.
replaced:
Let $M$ be a nondeterministic multi-tape Turing machine, $c$ a configuration of $M$ on some
input, and $w, w'$ choice words.  Running $M$ from $c$ under the concatenation $w w'$ gives
the same configuration as first running $M$ from $c$ under $w$ and then running $M$ under
$w'$ from the configuration so reached.
